permits.description: #414 - interior remodel, remove (e) guardrail & install new guardrail and handrail to (e) stairs. new bookcase wall to new walk-in closet, enclose laundry room. sprinkler work under separate permit (if required).

remove existing tub, install new shower stall in existing space, remove (e) single sink lavatory, install new double sink lavatory, add new electrical receptacles & change (e) lighting, upgrade shower plumbing valve.

kitchen remodel: replace in kind cabinets, counters, appliances. bath remodel: replace in kind vanity, tile floor, counter tops. no structural or plans, no new floor plans. no door, window, walls or ceiling on this permit.
replace one fixed skylight with one operable skylight. u-factor 0.40 maximum. more than 5' from property line same opening as existing skylight.
